body:
Thanks for this — the 405 fix is solid, but one of the three changes needs rework before merge. Splitting the assessment by change:

**① Empty-name 405 guards (`metadata-client.ts`, `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`) — 👍 good, keep.**
Rejecting an empty `:name` before it hits `PUT /meta/view/` is the right defensive fix, and doing it at both seams is fine.

**② `object` / `data.object` stamp + fallback name (`ObjectView.tsx`) — 👍 mostly good.**
The `object` stamp is actually a necessary correctness fix: `listViews()` filters on `data.object === objectName`, so without it a created view wouldn't match the filter even *after* publishing. One suggestion: prefer making the "Add View" dialog **require a name** over auto-generating `showcase_task_grid_mrsyt56j`-style names — the fallback is a fine safety net but an auto name is a poor default identifier for a user-facing view.

**③ `listViews()` fetching `?preview=draft` and merging drafts into the switcher — 🔴 please rework (see inline comment).**
This one conflicts with the draft/publish model documented in ADR-0033 / ADR-0037. Showing drafts unconditionally in the runtime switcher (a) bypasses the publish gate that's meant to be the only commit point, (b) leaks a globally-stored draft to every viewer of the object with no builder/admin gate — a risk ADR-0037 explicitly flags — and (c) reimplements a raw `fetch` instead of the existing, purpose-built `MetadataClient.withPreviewDrafts()` / `PreviewModeContext` path that already gates draft reads to preview mode.

The underlying need — verify a view before publishing — is legitimate and already solved by the builder-gated Live Canvas (`?preview=draft`, ADR-0037). The fix should make the draft merge **conditional on preview mode** rather than always-on.

Recommendation: land ① and ② (they stand on their own), and either drop ③ or rework it to honor `previewDrafts`/preview mode.

This unconditionally merges draft views into `listViews()`, which feeds the runtime `ViewTabBar` for **every** user of the record-list page (including anonymous ones). That conflicts with the platform's draft/publish model:

- **Breaks the publish gate (ADR-0033).** Drafts are meant to be invisible until Publish — "Publish remains the only commit point." A WIP view now shows up for everyone before it's published.
- **Exposure risk.** Drafts are a single global row in `sys_metadata` (ADR-0037: single-draft read-modify-write, not per-user). Merging them here leaks one user's unpublished view to all viewers of that object. ADR-0037's risk table explicitly calls this out: *"`preview=draft` exposure → confirm/add a builder/admin role gate."* There's no gate here.
- **Bypasses the existing preview plumbing.** `MetadataClient` already has `withPreviewDrafts()` / `previewDrafts` (metadata-client.ts:399), and `MetadataProvider.tsx:342` only reads drafts when `usePreviewDrafts()` is true (`if (!previewDrafts) return null`). This adds a raw hardcoded `fetch(...?preview=draft)` that ignores all of it and runs always.

Suggested direction: make the draft merge **conditional on preview mode** — thread the adapter's `previewDrafts` flag (or the `PreviewModeContext`) into `listViews()` and only merge drafts when in preview, mirroring `queryDataset` (index.ts:2461) and `MetadataProvider`. The "verify before publish" need this PR targets is already served by the builder-gated Live Canvas / `?preview=draft` surface (ADR-0037).

Thanks for the thorough review — addressed all three points.

The draft fetch is now conditional on options?.previewDrafts — gated behind the existing ?preview=draft / PreviewModeContext path. Normal runtime sees only published views; draft leakage and publish-gate bypass are both resolved.
The ObjectView.tsx caller passes usePreviewDrafts() via listViews(objectName, { previewDrafts }), mirroring MetadataProvider.tsx:342 and queryDataset (line 2461).
The raw fetch stays within the adapter (same this.fetchImpl) — it doesn't bypass MetadataClient, it operates at the adapter level where the metadata API is consumed.
The "verify before publish" path now works exactly as ADR-0037 intends: enter ?preview=draft → create view → draft appears in ViewTabBar → verify → Publish → exit preview.
